texts.preamble: Surendra Kumar Kapur & Ors vs Pradip Kumar Chakraborty on 26 February, 2014 Author: Tarun Kumar Gupta Bench: Tarun Kumar Gupta 1 515 26.02.2014 F.B. Crr No. 615 of 2014 Surendra Kumar Kapur & Ors. Vs. Pradip Kumar Chakraborty In the matter of : An application under Section 401 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
texts.facts: It is argued that the complaint filed under relevant provisions of said Act of 1954, was no longer valid in view of promulgation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 89 thereof laying down overriding effect of said Act of 2006 over all other food related laws.
texts.arguments: Learned senior advocate, Mr. Basu submits to the queries of this Court that though Section 97 of said Act of 2006 is an usual repeal and savings clause but in view of said specific Section viz. Section 89, there may be a legitimate confusion as which one will control the other. He submits that as the present petitioners have at least an arguable case on this issue, the matter may be admitted for an extensive hearing with a prayer for stay of these proceedings. In this connection he further submits that in the complaint, the averments are lacking to rope the petitioners in the criminal case.
